title: Schedule Delete allows removing appointments
custom_preconds: 1. A user has a role with Schedule View, Create & Edit and Delete.
custom_steps:
1. Open Schedule and find a test appointment.
  2. Delete it.
  3. Confirm.
viu_status: Blocked-UI: appointment delete requires selecting an existing appointment on the calendar (drag/slot interaction) which is not triggerable headless; same calendar-automation limitation as C26395.
